senses.gloss: उणक [uṇaka], a. (-की f.) Removing, driving out.

उणादिः [uṇādiḥ], A class of terminations beginning with उण्. m. pl. The class of कृत् affixes which begin with उण्.-Comp. -सूत्राणि The सूत्रs (Pāṇini iii. 3,I.4.75) treating of the उणादि affixes. ˚वृत्ति f. a commentary on the उणादि Sūtras.
